summary: Reconcile hidden inbox dismiss and snooze overlays using an authenticated exact control read after ACK and once on transport reconnect. Bounded feed omission and mutation receipts alone never prove application.

replay.detail: Proof read failures preserve accepted shared pending state for explicit retry or reconnect without resending the mutation. Undo retains fresh action keys and receipt-fenced revisions.

schema.detail: Consumes the generated attentionControlsGet endpoint and decoded AttentionControl schema; no local storage changes.

rules.detail: Control proofs match native id, semantic source revision, receipt revision and concrete state. Proofs do not settle source answers or insert hidden rows into the attention feed.

compatibility.detail: Custom action ports may omit proof reads; authoritative attention frames continue to reconcile their controls.

manual.detail: Deploy with the authenticated attention-control read endpoint and generated clients.

recovery.detail: Revert the consumer change; native control state remains server-owned.
